entries.summary: New standalone routed contact form plugin with 6 category cards
entries.notes: Cards: membership, vendors, convention, sponsorship, website, media. Each has configurable email recipients. Clicking a card shows an inline AJAX form.

entries.summary: Admin settings page for fallback email, BCC, per-category routing, and icon URL overrides
entries.notes: Settings > OHA Contact Router. Fallback: board@ohiohaunters.com. BCC: webmasterohiohaunters@gmail.com. Icon URL field per category overrides built-in SVG.

entries.summary: Dark OHA theme CSS with high-specificity selectors throughout
entries.notes: All selectors prefixed with .oha-cr-wrap. Critical properties use !important. Colors: #0d0000 card bg, #AD3119 accent, #E76653 light accent, #FF0000 required asterisk.
